title: Nourishing Molten Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A citrusy and molten Tunisian dish featuring thyme and katsuramuki-cut ingredients, perfect for a nourishing meal, this recipe is also FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the thyme, lemon juice, orange juice, garlic-infused oil, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the katsuramuki-cut carrots and zucchini, and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
